 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjeev Narula
 Order

The Petitioner is the Complainant in case FIR No. 390/2024 dated 5th September, 2024,
registered under Sections 498A, 406 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at P.S. Kanjhawala,
Delhi.
The Petitioner alleges that despite registration of the FIR, no meaningful investigation has been carried out till date.

2. Aggrieved, the present writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, seeks a direction to Respondent No. 2 for the replacement of the current IO and appointment of another officer to ensure a fair, effective and complete investigation.
The Petitioner also seeks action against Respondent Nos. 3 and 4 for delinquency of their duties.
This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 09/07/2025 at 21:55:55 3.
Mr. Anand V. Khatri, ASC for the State, controverts the allegations made in the petition.
He submits that during investigation, it has been revealed that the Complainant's husband is currently not in India.

Accordingly, the IO initiated correspondence with the Bureau of Immigration,
Foreigners Regional Registration Office, requesting details of the passport, entry and exit records Muskan vs State Of Delhi & Ors on 8 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2388280/
1 from India, and the current immigration status of the individual concerned.

sentences.text: Notice to this effect has also been served upon the Complainant's husband.
He further submits that the investigation is ongoing and that all necessary steps are being taken by the IO.
4. In response, counsel for the Petitioner contends that the Petitioner is being pressured into settling the matter.
It is further submitted that no arrest has been made so far and that the dowry articles are yet to be recovered.

5. In the opinion of the Court, if the Petitioner has any grievance relating to the investigation,
Petitioner shall be free to approach the Court of the concerned Magistrate with the appropriate application.
6. The present petition is disposed of, along with pending application, if any with liberty as aforesaid.
7. The Court has not commented on the merits of the case.
All rights and contentions of the parties are left open.
However, the statement of ASC for the State is taken on record that the IO shall proceed in the matter as expeditiously as possible.
SANJEEV NARULA, J JULY 8, 2025 d.negi
